It's no secret that Feelings Cafe, located beneath (and related to) Bhava, is one of my favorite dining experiences in New Orleans. Between the beautiful courtyard that is quintessentially NOLA and that rustic French countrysidesque interior, combined with an entire vegan menu that I don't have to tell you is pretty rare here, it truly is as good as it gets. I don't go a lot because I tend to look at it as a special occasion place (we have to have those). Similarly, I just loved the bohemian French Sentiments Wine Dive formerly located above Feelings. I'm a long time fan of Chef Anne Churchill. I used to head to The Bridge Lounge when she cooked there, and always made a beeline when she was at the Green Plate/Crescent City Farmers Market and of course at Bacchanal too but am glad she is now rooting herself at her own Bhava. I have already eaten there four times and have brought different people every time who also loved the menu. The "cheese" plate, the tamales, soups are constant favorites of mine, but my number one is the tofu crabby cakes. Just pick a bunch of items and put away your thoughts about vegan and vegetarian foods and just have a healthy meal flavored beautifully offered in a lovely setting by a great chef.
